tools.name: settle_verify
tools.description: 0.003 USDC per call via x402, no key (unpaid call returns PaymentRequired; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Verify an x402 settlement on Base USDC right now (by tx hash, or payer+nonce / paymentPayload via USDC.authorizationState). Returns settled|failed|pending|not_settled|expired|unknown.

tools.name: settle_watch
tools.description: Watch a timed-out/unknown x402 settlement: re-checked on-chain for up to 24h; POSTs your webhook when it becomes settled/failed/expired. Needs a key mts_ (X-API-Key header or apiKey argument). No key? call settle_trial_key (free, 50 calls/7 days). Full plan 1 USDC/30d incl. 1,000 calls via x402.

tools.name: settle_gate_claim
